label: Packaged Food
description: Pre-packaged food products sold at retail.

fields.label: Product Name
fields.description: Common or generic name of the food product.
fields.fix: Print the common name of the food prominently on the principal display panel.

fields.label: Ingredient List
fields.description: Full ingredient list in descending order of weight.
fields.fix: List every ingredient in descending order of weight, prefixed with 'Ingredients:'.

fields.label: Allergen Declaration
fields.description: Declaration of major allergens contained in the product.
fields.fix: Add a 'Contains:' statement naming every major allergen present.

fields.label: Net Quantity
fields.description: Net weight or volume in metric units.
fields.fix: State net quantity in metric units (e.g. 250 g or 500 ml).

fields.label: Expiry / Best Before
fields.fix: Print a 'Best Before' or 'Use By' date in a legible format.

fields.label: Manufacturer / Packer
fields.description: Name and address of the manufacturer or packer.
fields.fix: Include the name and full address of the manufacturer, packer or importer.

fields.label: Country of Origin
fields.description: Country where the product was made.
fields.fix: Add a country of origin statement, e.g. 'Made in India'.

fields.label: Nutrition Information
fields.description: Nutrition facts per 100 g / 100 ml or per serving.
fields.fix: Add a nutrition panel with energy, fat, carbohydrate, protein and salt values.

fields.label: Batch / Lot Number
fields.description: Batch or lot identifier for traceability.
fields.fix: Print a batch or lot code for traceability.

fields.label: Storage Instructions
fields.description: How the product should be stored.
fields.fix: Add storage guidance such as 'Store in a cool, dry place'.
